environment.description: Django 4.2 application deployed on EC2 behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). Frontend is a React SPA that renders note.content using dangerouslySetInnerHTML for rich-text display. Authentication tokens are long-lived (30-day expiry) issued via /api/token/ endpoint. No Content-Security-Policy headers configured. bleach==5.0.1 installed which does NOT strip javascript: from href attributes by default when protocols parameter is not explicitly set.
